repos_data.description: Apple Mail MCP server with full-coverage FTS5 body search. Reliable on large mailboxes where AppleScript-based servers timeout.

An MCP server that securely interfaces with your iMessage database via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), allowing LLMs to query and analyze iMessage conversations. It includes robust phone number validation, attachment processing, contact management, group chat handling, and full support for sending and receiving messages.
Local MCP server for Claude Desktop to read Outlook emails/bodies/attachments and send local files as attachments.
MCP server for Outlook email, calendar, and contacts — let your AI assistant manage your inbox directly from the conversation.
MCP server for MultiMail — Verifiable identity email for AI agents
MCP server for email deliverability testing across 9 providers. Test inbox placement (Inbox vs Spam vs Promotions) with SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf.
MCP server for ZeroDrop — gives AI agents disposable inboxes with auto-extracted OTPs and magic links. Claude, Cursor, Claude Code.
MCP server for Zoho Mail — read, search, and send email via Claude
MCP server for Postcard.bot — let AI agents send real printed postcards. Works with Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP client.
188+ local tools for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor & Grok — Mail, iMessage, Teams, Slack, WhatsApp, OneDrive, Google Drive, Zoom, Outlook, Office. Native macOS, 100% local, no API keys.
A reliable, native Gmail MCP server with full mailbox control — including snooze.

repo_meta_data.description: MCP server for Apple Mail: sub-ms search over 300k+ messages via Mail's own SQLite index, verified sends, Exchange body backfill, triage plan/review/apply. 849 tests, MIT.
